profile.headline: Software Engineer at Bloomberg LP
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Hello! I'm Christian Reyes, a first-generation college graduate and current software engineer interested in the intersection of technology, sustainability, and altruism. I am passionate about using my problem-solving skills to create software that is usable, accessible, and affordable for all. I want to use what I learn from a career in computing and apply my skills to directly benefit those in need. I'm looking to get involved in any way I can!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: MLT Career Prep Fellow
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
positions.description: -Emerged as one of 1,000 applicants for an 18-month professional development program for high-achieving diverse talent

positions.title: Data Structures & Algorithms I Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
-Collaborate with 40 other TAs and 3 professors to teach object-oriented programming and data structures to 500+ students
-Contribute to course structure by providing feedback to professors, grading assignments/exams, and managing student inquiries 
-Reinforce key concepts to individual students in weekly office hours by asking questions and being a source of encouragement

positions.title: MakeToLearn Lab Assistant
positions.description:
-Design and construct hands-on projects that involve building technologies using digital design software, 3D printers, coding, and Arduinos for a class of 15 students
-Provide instruction to ensure a basic understanding of the tools used in class as well as hold office hours outside of class time
-Coordinate lesson plans and prototype future projects with instructors

positions.title: San Francisco Tech Lab Fellow
positions.description:
-Selected as one of 28 Black and Latinx engineers for a three day intensive program to create a portfolio manager using Python and Jupyter Notebook
-Collaborated with Bloomberg software engineers + peers and attended interactive sessions focused on technical interview skills in Bloomberg's San Francisco office
-Increased financial knowledge and learned about Bloomberg’s market leading technology through senior leadership

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Updated a predefined report to include two additional data breakouts as tables by modifying the existing codebase to handle a new response structure from an internal API
-pushed code to production
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Environment · POI · Java · JUnit · Spring Boot

positions.title: New Technologist
positions.description:
-Prototyped a high-fidelity solution to combat food insecurity through a learning and cooking portal targeted towards high minority, low-income communities in collaboration with 4 other team members
-Employed a recipe API search engine that fetched 8000+ quick-and-easy vegan recipes and synced it with the front-end
-Acquired real world experience in web development and program management through hands-on training from senior staff at Microsoft

honors.title: Hispanic Scholarship Fund Scholar
honors.description: Recognized as a member of a nationwide network of Scholars and Alumni. Deemed an HSF Scholar and finalist for the HSF Scholarship.
honors.issuer: Issued by Hispanic Scholarship Fund · Jun 2022

honors.title: VA–NC Alliance Academic Achievement Award
honors.description: The VA–NC Alliance recognizes the academic success and leadership development of STEM students.
honors.issuer: Issued by The Virginia–North Carolina Louis Stokes Alliance for Minority Participation · Aug 2021

volunteerExperiences.description:
-Foster growth and maturity of middle school students in the local community through personal anecdotes, real-world examples, and weekly presentations on different aspects of life
-Inspire young men of color to construct personal, academic, and professional skills in a group and one-on-one setting with purpose of increasing retention rates and building a sense of community
-Engage in 13 MOCHA sessions over academic year to capture essence of five program pillars: Integrity, Ambition, Achievement, Service, and Health & Wellness

-Collaborated with peers to teach a group of 20-30 special needs students basketball basics and the essence of teamwork for 3-5 hours a week
-Coordinated drills for 25+ team practices and worked closely with a group of 3 students to develop skills and provide companionship
-Competed alongside in over 6 games and 2 tournaments against 7 other schools, promoting healthy competition
